answers.core: This cannot be done through an add-on and is generally useful to GDExtensions that need to exclude the editor during setup before `INITIALIZATION_LEVEL_SCENE`.
answers.workaround: No. `Engine::editor_hint` is set based on a combination of compiler flags and command line arguments, so it cannot be reverse-engineered in the GDExtension and must be accessed through `Engine::is_editor_hint`. Exposing `Engine::is_editor_hint` or passing its value to GDExtension requires the engine to be modified.

title: Add `Engine::is_editor_hint()` equivalent for GDExtensions initialized before `INITIALIZATION_LEVEL_SCENE`
